title: Cayley Graphs Of Order $pqrs$ Are Hamiltonian
summary: Assume $ G $ is a finite group with order $ |G| = pqrs $, where $ p $, $ q $, $ r $, and $ s $ are distinct prime numbers. We prove that every connected Cayley graph of $ G $ contains a hamiltonian cycle. Our result drops all restrictions of all previously known results on hamiltonian cycles in Cayley graphs of groups of order $pqrs$.
